template:
You are working in a Python repository checked out at /testbed. Resolve the GitHub issue below by editing the repository's files in place.

<issue>
<<ISSUE>>
</issue>

<<WORKFLOW>>

Work only inside /testbed. Do not commit and do not create branches. When you are done, stop and reply with a one-line summary of what you changed.

workflows.A: Workflow: investigate the code to understand the issue, implement a fix, and then stop.
workflows.B: Workflow: investigate the code to understand the issue and implement a fix. Then run the repository's existing tests that are relevant to your change, analyse any failures, revise the fix, and repeat. Do this for at most 5 test-fix cycles, where one cycle is one test run followed by a revision of your fix in response to a failure. Stop earlier if the relevant tests pass or you can make no further progress. Then stop.
